Ben (Sales): Quick check for ACME POC — customer needs explicit acceptance criteria for tenant routing and data residency. They want to confirm which regions we can guarantee, what sub-processors see egress, and fallback routing behavior. Any blockers for Q3 deal? cc @Priya
Priya (Solutions Eng): Thanks. Quick answers: hosted API supports regional endpoints in eu-west-1, eu-central-1, us-west-2, asia-southeast-1. We can pin a tenant to a region for the POC. For strict EU-only residency we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments. :point_down: example config below for routing pin
Priya (Solutions Eng): ```
region_preference:
  preferred: eu-west-1
  fallback: none  # use Dedicated/Private to avoid fallback
  subprocessor_whitelist:
    - cloudedge
    - storagepartner
    - redwood-delivery
```
Luca - NetOps: Subprocessors we use for this stack: CloudEdge (edge caching), TransitCorp (network egress/peering), StoragePartner (blob backups). Full inventory here: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors. Note: TransitCorp routes may touch US backbone; if customer requires EU-only we must avoid TransitCorp or use Private. @Aisha FYI for contract impact.
Aisha (Legal Ops): Legal: we'll need a completed DPA + the security questionnaire filled out. Also flag: TransitCorp has US egress in their route map — if ACME needs strictly EU egress we must go with Dedicated/Private or accept a subprocess restriction which adds ~15% ops surcharge. I'll raise an approval ticket for the exception.
Ben (Sales): Got it. Customer is okay with a small premium but wants SLOs and a guarantee of no cross-border egress for the POC. Can we promise that with Dedicated?
Priya (Solutions Eng): Yes — Dedicated with geo-isolated GPU pools + VPC peering removes cross-region egress for customer traffic (no TransitCorp path). Ops needs ~14 business days lead time and a commitment size (monthly). Ballpark pricing: reserved capacity +$12k/month or ~+20% on pay-as-you-go depending on qps. I will prepare a formal quote and SLO language.
OncallBot: deploy-bot created ticket DL-3487: "Provision dedicated geo-isolated pool for ACME POC" ETA ~14 days.
Luca - NetOps: Ops checklist for provisioning: customer IP allowlist, peering CIDR, certs for TLS, KMS BYOK info if they want key isolation, expected traffic (qps and typical seq length). Also will need subproc whitelist confirmation.
Ben (Sales): I'll send contact info and expected traffic tonight. Thanks team :thumbsup: Will keep ACME updated and kick off the security questionnaire with Legal.
